'''Horizon Island''' was an island located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. A jungle island, Horizon Island was the site of the port town of [[Raider's Cove]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and the town was located on the eastern end of the island. The [[Western Jungle Expanse]] lay to the west of the city, with hills and canyons such as [[Skyline River Pass]] and [[Gorge Hollow River Pass]] forming a barrier between the two. The [[Nova Blades]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang, made their headquarters in the crashed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Aggressor (Rishi)|''Aggressor'']] that lay in the western mountains of the island. [[Shaclaw]]s, known locally as shore crabs, were common along the beaches, and the jungles were filled with [[tonitran]] lizards, [[jungle wampa]]s, [[krak'jya]]s, [[Skar'kla]]s and [[Orobird/Legends|Giant Rishi orobirds]].<ref name="TOR" />
